notes_for_editor: Built-year conflict, unresolved: Forest Lookouts quotes a 1921 Potlatch TPA report of a new lookout point on Potato Hill (a line built to it); firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts date the 15-foot L-4 tower to 1939, and the April 1939 newspaper item describes the station being set up. Whether the 1921 point was a structure is not known. Names: the 1939 item calls the mountain Mount Dreary, also known as Potato Hill; onX calls it Spud Hill. Current use: a cell tower per onX (a trail guide; no date given). Access level 'restricted' is our reading of a gated trailhead and private-land crossing; no source says the summit is closed. Record kind tower and status gone agree with sources; record events already hold 1964 destroyed. No corrections proposed.
